subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by `artifacts.download` use the existing `operator.read` artifact contract, or require `operator.admin`?
rationale: This is a durable Gateway authorization boundary rather than a mechanical implementation choice; the intended principal for bytes that were previously only served through the protected HTTP route requires owner intent.

options.title: Confirm `operator.read`
options.body: Keep the branch’s read-scoped RPC path after exact-head proof shows session, record, transcript, and coordinate checks prevent cross-session access.

options.title: Require `operator.admin`
options.body: Change the artifact handler, protocol wording, UI recovery behavior, and tests so managed-image bytes remain an explicit elevated-scope exception.

recommendation.title: Confirm `operator.read`
recommendation.body: Keep the branch’s read-scoped RPC path after exact-head proof shows session, record, transcript, and coordinate checks prevent cross-session access.

likelyOwner.reason: They were directly asked to confirm this Gateway authorization contract in the PR discussion.
